QUILLMARK LABS DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE: fictional vendor, written for testing.

1. Subprocessors. Quillmark's current subprocessors are listed at the Quillmark trust center. Quillmark will give Customer at least 30 days' notice before adding or replacing a subprocessor.

2. Processing Instructions. Quillmark will process personal data only on Customer's documented instructions, including with regard to transfers.

3. Deletion. On termination, Quillmark will delete Customer personal data within 30 days unless law requires otherwise.
